tradeoff.description: What happens if the user picks this, in one plain line: what they will see, what it costs and what it buys (e.g. "Old rows are deleted for good; the export runs twice as fast").

choice.description: The answer you recommend (one of the options' labels when there are options).

recommendation.description: Your recommended answer. Required: the user can accept it as is.

kind.description: The vis kind, e.g. "wireframe", "flow", "state", "steps" (call vis_guide with it first).

source.description: The drawing's source, exactly what the vis fence's body would be, in the syntax vis_guide returned.

anyOf.description: A drawing on the alignment card, only when it explains faster than words; at most 3 per alignment.

visual.description: The question's drawing; null removes it.
